```{r}
#| include: false
read_table <- function(name) utils::read.csv(file.path("outputs/tables", name), check.names = FALSE)
```

## KMO and Bartlett prechecks

```{r}
knitr::kable(read_table("efa_prechecks.csv"), digits = 4)
```

## Scree information

![](figures/scree_plot.png){fig-alt="Scree plot of eigenvalues from the 30-item correlation matrix." width=90%}

```{r}
head_vals <- read_table("correlation_eigenvalues.csv")
knitr::kable(head_vals[1:10, ], digits = 3)
```

## Five-factor principal-axis EFA

The repository fits five factors because the Figshare codebook documents five conceptual scales. This is an exploratory diagnostic, not confirmatory factor analysis.

```{r}
loadings <- read_table("efa_5factor_pattern_loadings.csv")
knitr::kable(loadings, digits = 3)
```

## EFA-derived CR and AVE

```{r}
knitr::kable(read_table("efa_derived_cr_ave.csv"), digits = 3)
```

These CR/AVE values are derived from single-factor exploratory loadings within each documented scale. They are provided as transparent descriptive diagnostics and **must not be represented as CFA/SEM measurement-model estimates**.
